summary.name: Hedra
summary.one_liner: Hedra is a visual AI company offering model inference optimization and hosting, custom model development for visual and multimodal models, and a research lab working on vision and world models.
keywords: deploy video model without serving stack
use_cases: serve a multimodal or diffusion model in production
reduce latency and GPU cost of visual models
build a custom visual or video model for a specific problem
research on embodied AI and robot simulation
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Hedra as a company that builds models for generating, perceiving, and predicting visual content, plus the platform that runs them. Its Production Inference service applies distillation and inference optimization to a customer's multimodal models and hosts them on Hedra's infrastructure. Its Model Factory offers forward-deployed researchers who work with a customer's team to build models for a specific problem and hardware. WMR is described as an engine for multimodal training and inference, focused on diffusion, video, and world models, optimizing attention across frames, numerical precision, and batching/caching. The page also lists research work from Hedra, including Magic 1-for-1 video generation, Phased Consistency Models, and several embodied AI and robotics projects.
notable: WMR: inference and training engine purpose-built for diffusion, video, and world models
Hosted production inference so teams do not need their own serving stack
Forward-deployed researchers for custom model building
Research lab publications including Magic 1-for-1 and BEHAVIOR-1K
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; enterprise engagement is implied by the talk-to-engineers call to action
Recursive self-improvement is labeled as a research preview
The listing describes Hedra as a free personal AI creation studio, which the page itself does not mention
